reference/agents.md

Agent Index

Roles come from plugins/*/agents/*.md. Their responsibilities are shared; the host decides how to instantiate a worker.

Concern Claude Code Codex
Delegate a role Agent with subagent_type: "<name>" (plugin namespace when required) Ask the bridge for agent_instructions, then start a fresh native subagent with the returned instructions
Available add-on roles Install the add-on plugin First-party roles are bundled in the native package
Model column below Claude alias from the role's source frontmatter Descriptive source metadata only; inherit the active Codex model unless the user supplies a supported mapping
Skills and restrictions Role frontmatter and host rules Pass preloadSkillPaths, declaredTools, rulePaths and the job's result schema to the worker
Project memory Host-supported agent memory .ai/agents/<role>.md, only for roles declaring project memory and subject to user preferences

A role is an instruction set, not a guarantee that the host registers a native agent type with the same name. Codex may use a generic native subagent loaded with the requested SDD role. Independent reviews use fresh context; the worker must return real evidence rather than fabricated checks. Path-scoped Markdown rules apply only to matching files and are separate from Codex shell-permission .rules files.

Source: native role loader, provider mapping.
